payout_quote: Get $50 & Give $100 when your friend opens a checking account. Get $100 & Give $100 when your friend closes on a mortgage.
steps: Be a Climb Credit Union member 18+; fill out the member referral form to register and get your unique referral code
Invite friends/family via social media or email
Friend registers, joins Climb, and opens a checking account with recurring direct deposits totaling $500+ within 90 days (or closes a first mortgage within 90 days)
You receive $50 (checking) or $100 (mortgage) cash deposited into your share account once qualifications are met
catches: Referral form must be submitted at initial account opening — no retroactive credit
Friend must not have been a Climb member within the previous year
Checking route: recurring direct deposits totaling $500+ within 90 days; mortgage route: close a first mortgage within 90 days
Bonus paid as interest; subject to IRS tax reporting
Both members must own a share, be current on obligations, and have no outstanding losses to the CU
Rewards deposited up to 120 days from account opening; employees not eligible
biggest_catch: The referral only counts if your code is attached at the moment your friend opens the account — miss that and you get nothing, plus checking referrals need $500+ of direct deposits.
eligibility: Climb Credit Union members 18+; referred friends must be new members (not a member within the previous year)
timing: Friend qualifies within 90 days of account opening; payout deposited once qualified (up to 120 days from opening)

when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Friend qualifies within 90 days of account opening; payout deposited once qualified (up to 120 days from opening) — structural: payout can take up to ~120 days from account opening.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
